description_en: Queries the list of Supabase data backups
name: ListSupabaseDataBackups

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the Supabase instance. You can obtain instance ID from the Supabase page in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase实例ID，可以在控制台Supabase页面获取
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30
50
100

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数。取值说明：

30
50
100

默认值：30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0 and cannot exceed the maximum value of an integer. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间。格式： yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup set. You can obtain the ID from the BackupSetId parameter returned by the ListSupabaseDataBackups operation
parameters.help_zh: 备份集 ID。可从 ListSupabaseDataBackups 返回的 BackupSetId 获取
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Valid values: DATA: full backup; RESTOREPOI: restorable point
parameters.help_zh: 备份类型。DATA：全量备份；RESTOREPOI：可恢复点
parameters.name: data_type

parameters.help_en: The backup pattern. Valid values: Automated: automatic backup. Manual: manual backup
parameters.help_zh: 备份模式。Automated：系统自动备份；Manual：手动备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en: The status of the backup set. Valid values: Success: the backup is successful; Failed: the backup fails
parameters.help_zh: 备份集状态。Success：备份成功；Failed：备份失败
parameters.name: backup_status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The paging token for paged query. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, specify the NextToken value returned by the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询标记。首次查询不传入；后续查询传入上一次响应返回的 NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

BackupEndTime.description_en: The end time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
BackupEndTime.description_zh: 备份结束时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

BackupEndTimeLocal.description_en: The local time representation of the backup end time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The current return value is in Beijing time (UTC+8). The trailing Z is a fixed character in the compatibility format and does not indicate the zero time zone. To parse the time in a standard format, use BackupEndTime
BackupEndTimeLocal.description_zh: 备份结束时间的本地时间表示，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。当前返回值为北京时间（UTC+8）；末尾 Z 是兼容格式中的固定字符，不表示零时区。需要按标准时间格式解析时，请使用 BackupEndTime

BackupMethod.description_en: The backup method. Valid values: Physical: physical backup; Snapshot: snapshot backup
BackupMethod.description_zh: 备份方式。Physical：物理备份；Snapshot：快照备份

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode.

Valid values for automatic backups:

Automated: automatic system backup.
Manual: manual backup.

Valid values for restorable points:

Automated: the restorable point after a automatic backup.
Manual: the restorable point manually triggered by the user.
Period: the restorable point triggered periodically based on the backup policy
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。

全量备份取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

恢复点取值说明：

Automated：全量备份后的恢复点。
Manual：用户手动触发的恢复点。
Period：因为备份策略，定时触发的恢复点

BackupSetId.description_en: The ID of the backup set

BackupSize.description_en: The size of the backup file. Unit: bytes
BackupSize.description_zh: 备份文件大小，单位：Byte（字节）

BackupStartTime.description_en: The start time of the backup. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
BackupStartTime.description_zh: 备份开始时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间

BackupStartTimeLocal.description_en: The local time representation of the backup start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The current return value is in Beijing time (UTC+8). The trailing Z is a fixed character in the compatibility format and does not indicate the zero time zone. To parse the time in a standard format, use BackupStartTime
BackupStartTimeLocal.description_zh: 备份开始时间的本地时间表示，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。当前返回值为北京时间（UTC+8）；末尾 Z 是兼容格式中的固定字符，不表示零时区。需要按标准时间格式解析时，请使用 BackupStartTime

BackupStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup set. Valid values:

Success: successful.
Failure: failed
BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：成功。
Failure：失败

BaksetName.description_en: The name of the restorable point or the full backup set
BaksetName.description_zh: 恢复点名称或全量备份集名称

ConsistentTime.description_en: The consistency point in time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. For a full backup, this parameter indicates the consistency point in time of the backup. For a restorable point, this parameter indicates the point in time to which data can be restored
ConsistentTime.description_zh: 一致性时间点，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位：秒。全量备份表示备份的一致性时间点，可恢复点表示可恢复的时间点

DataType.description_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

DATA: full backup.
RESTOREPOI: restorable point
DataType.description_zh:
备份类型。取值说明：

DATA：全量备份。
RESTOREPOI：可恢复点

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. You can use this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页的查询标记，可作为下次请求的 NextToken

PageSize.description_en: The number of backup sets on the current page

TotalBackupSize.description_en: The total size of the backup sets. Unit: bytes
